name: Bawan Company
summary: Bawan Company manufactures and sells metal and steel works in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The Metal and Wood segment engages in the production of wooden pallets, plywood panels, medium and high-density boards coated with paper, decorative wood, containers, wooden boxes, prefabricated buildings, steel buildings, forming and bending of reinforcing steel, and contracting. It is also involved in repairing, demolishing, rebuilding, and constructing residential, commercial and public buildings, educational, recreational and health facilities, as well as maintaining, operating, and installing electrical and electronic equipment, electrical devices and systems, aluminum works, iron and wooden doors…
